description: The Brompton x CHPT3 4th Edition means business. Providing the power you need to transform every moment of your life into a positive experience, the handbuilt beauty perfectly combines style and expert engineering. Presenting a sturdy yet lightweight steel frame, this model is more than 3.3 lbs lighter than the original bike. This means you can get around easily and still experience the smooth riding style that Brompton is adored for. The durable 4-speed system gears which provide enhanced control will aid you in your city exploration. Offering everything from pace-filled acceleration to a stable, planted position on the saddle, you can keep your eyes are firmly fixed on the horizon of opportunities that await you.This bike is also designed for maximum usability and performance. To ensure that no weather or location is match for this cycling masterpiece, the power coating is weather resistant and ideal for all conditions. Furthermore, additional features, including the trendy limited edition Frame Pouch Bag, long-lasting inner tubes, and reactive brakes, make for a safer riding experience. Comfort is also guaranteed thanks to the robust suspension and vibration-absorbing seat. Style is also something that you cannot miss with this statement bike. Every detail has been hand-crafted by the London Brompton team. With finishing touches such as the stitched saddle and 3-dimensional coating, you will surely be amazed by every element of this go-getter biking masterpiece. Designed to withstand rough rides and provide a smooth cycling session, the Brompton x CHPT3 4th Edition will add a new sense of optimism and excitement to everyday life.

components.description: Advance chain tensioner with replaceable hanger mounting
Superlight Titanium fork with a threaded headset

Each bike comes with a limited-edition CHPT3 x Brompton Frame Pouch Bag, The frame pouch bag has been designed to fit securely inside the triangle on the bikes' mainframe and contains 1x Tubolito lightweight inner tube.
Ergon GE1 Evo Slim – A premium ergonomic, rider-oriented grip with more comfort, precision and performance
Brompton Folding left hand and non-folding right-hand pedals
Machined aluminium seat clamp and rear frame clip in anodised matt black finish
Schwalbe One Tanwall - Developed specifically for the CHPT3 bike with class leading grip, weight and rolling speed
Machined aluminium hinge clamp levers and plates anodised matt black finish
Lightweight rim, double-butted spokes and aluminium hub body with sealed bearings, newly developed 4 speed freehub body and hex key axle
